fetched_title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Introduces Independent-Communicate-Revise, which fixes initial trajectories and measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness against a no-message revision control. Recovery when both agents are initially wrong is reported as rare, but the design is about message channels, with no checker-graded valid/invalid critiques or mediation estimate seen.
